WITH signal_data AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    pulsepersec
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg
  FROM signal_data
),
telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signal_data
  GROUP BY telescref
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    ta.telescref, 
    ta.avg_pulse,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > oa.overall_avg
),
second_avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.telescref,
    ao.avg_pulse,
    ao.overall_avg,
    sa.second_avg
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN second_avg_cte sa
  WHERE ao.avg_pulse > sa.second_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse,
  AVG(avg_pulse - overall_avg) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(avg_pulse - second_avg) as avg_above_second
FROM final_telescopes
